prose: The Financial Times reports, citing sources, that Tencent signed a roughly $7 billion, five-year deal with Oracle this year to access about 100,000 advanced AI chips that are unavailable in China, through Oracle's Southeast Asian data centers. It comes as the WeChat owner races ByteDance and Alibaba. Based on the Techmeme excerpt.
highlights: Tencent-Oracle deal worth about $7B over five years
Capacity sits in Southeast Asian data centers
Context: competition with ByteDance and Alibaba
Basis: Techmeme excerpt of FT, sources unnamed
